description: The cheapest (or lowest-carbon) run of `duration_hours` starting from the next half hour and finishing by the next `finish_by` – when to set a washing machine or dishwasher's delay timer.

duration_hours.description: How long it runs, 0.5-12 in half hours (default 3.5).

export.description: How export is paid: `paired` (the tariff's own export tariff, default), `fixed` (with export_rate), `fit` (the Feed-in Tariff's deemed export: paid whatever is exported, so the sun used at home gives nothing up), `none`, or an export tariff's key from list_tariffs?direction=export (used where the tariff can have it, else its own).

finish_by.description: Local time it must finish by, HH:MM (default 07:00) – the next one at least `duration_hours` away.

kwh.description: Energy the run uses, kWh (0-20), for its cost – on the energy label, or kW times hours. Leave out for no cost.

optimise.description: `cost` (default) or `carbon` (NESO's regional forecast, about two days ahead).

region.description: Agile region: a letter A-P, the slug from list_regions (eg `C` or `london`), or one of the well-known places list_regions lists for it (eg `Manchester`).

solar_facing.description: The way they face: S, SE, SW, E, W, NE, NW or N – or a bearing in degrees (south is 180). Default S.

solar_inverter_kw.description: The inverter's limit, kW (0.5-50), if smaller than the panels.

solar_kwp.description: The home's solar panels, kWp (0.2-50): the answer then counts their forecast spare sun – see the docs' Solar panels section.

solar_pitch.description: Their angle from flat, degrees (0-90, default 35).

tariff.description: A tariff's key from list_tariffs (default `agile`), eg `go`, `edf-go-electric`, `eon-next-drive`.
